summary: Meet brings two upright index fingers together, like two people walking up to each other. It's the second half of 'nice to meet you.'
movement: Hands come together until the fingers touch
steps: Hold both index fingers up, a few inches apart, palms facing each other.
Bring them together until the knuckles touch.
To say 'nice to meet you,' sign NICE first and flow straight into MEET.
mistakes: Crossing the fingers past each other. They meet and stop.
